items.question: How long does the keratin straightening effect last?
items.answer: The effect lasts 3 to 5 months, depending on hair type and care routine. After the treatment, hair requires sulphate-free shampoos to extend the result.

items.question: Is the treatment safe for colour-treated hair?
items.answer: Yes. We use exclusively formaldehyde-free formulas, safe for coloured, bleached, and chemically treated hair. Magdalena assesses the hair condition during consultation and selects the right formula.

items.question: What is the difference between keratin straightening and keratin regeneration?
items.answer: Keratin straightening smooths and relaxes the hair curl — the result is perfectly straight, smooth hair. Keratin regeneration focuses on rebuilding structure and moisture while preserving the natural curl. Magdalena will help you choose the right treatment during your consultation.

items.question: Do I need to do anything before my appointment?
items.answer: Come with clean, unstyled hair. Do not use any oils or masks the day before the treatment. The treatment takes 2.5–4 hours, so it's worth planning your whole day around it.

items.question: When can I wash my hair after the treatment?
items.answer: We recommend the first wash 48–72 hours after the treatment. During this time, do not tie, braid, or wet your hair. Magdalena will give you detailed aftercare instructions.
